title: EdgeTriage
subtitle: Low-Bandwidth Medical Image Triage for Offline Rural Clinics.
fileLimitText: PNG, JPG or DICOM exports up to 10MB
rationaleBody: Running Hugging Face's MobileViT local classifier directly inside the browser using ONNX WebAssembly removes all external cloud API dependency. Clinics can process clinical scans inside local browser sandboxes without internet connection, preserving zero latency and total patient privacy.
